findings.behavior: The map button onclick passed MouseEvent as the restore flag, so clicking saved-map-only while online skipped removal.

changes: Share one rolling TileRequestWindow per tile-server URL origin in the current page, across map removal, navigation, template/name changes and background toggles. Keep view limit80, concurrency4, default32/min and finite retry behavior.

Charge every started fetch including failures/retries and sent aborts; do not charge deduplicated requests, canceled queued tiles or a per-view refusal before any fetch. Exact rolling60s expiry only permits a later manual request; no timed replay.
Expose per-map attempts and per-origin recent minute usage separately. Describe32/min as an app limit, not a provider entitlement.

Defer layer status notification until Leaflet finishes the current adding stack. Ignore fetch/image callbacks for removed or offscreen tiles, complete active images once, clear unload handlers and revoke tracked Blob URLs.
Wrap manual map button invocation so its event cannot be interpreted as restore=true. Keep existing explicit restore=true path for navigation.
